skill1: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.
skill2: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 ATK buff trigger: kit says 'Activates when own HP falls below 90%'. The sim models no HP pool and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the literal trigger NEVER fires. Modeled as `passive` with the 5s duration retained as a placeholder — this is an UNMEASURED uptime assumption and is the single largest source of error in this override. If the real uptime is intermittent, this over-credits the team's ATK for the whole fight.
⚑ skill2 hitCount 120: 'normal attack(s)' read as ROUNDS fired by ade (1/pull, AR ammo 60), so the trigger lands roughly every two magazines. Not verified against a popup/buff-apply cadence.

⚑ Both Max HP grants use casterMaxHpPct ('of the skill user's Max HP'). Per the e3 rule ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, so these are offensively INERT at scope lock; kept for kit completeness and any future HP-scaling consumer.
⚑ Burst keyed to burstCast (her own Burst II cast), not fullBurstEnter. If the buff is observed on rotations where ade does NOT burst, this is wrong and under-credits.
skill2's 420-normal-attack Perfect Maid line is unmodeled (debuff immunity, no damage path and no schema kind). At AR cadence 420 rounds is reached late in a 180s fight, if at all.
FB-by-timing left default ON for all buffs; noFb not set (measured-only). noRange not set (engine-automatic).
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. ade is a Wind/AR/Supporter Burst II whose entire damage contribution to a team is buff-side: two casterAtkPct grants (5.19% skill1, 10.15% burst) and two casterMaxHpPct grants (15.62% skill2, 25.15% burst), all targeting all allies. The two Perfect Maid debuff-immunity lines are defensive utility with no schema representation and no damage path — recorded verbatim in `unmodeled`. The load-bearing uncertainty is skill1's HP-threshold trigger, which cannot fire in a sim with no HP pool against a partless boss that deals no damage; it is modeled as an always-on passive, which is an UPTIME ASSUMPTION, not a reading of the kit. Treat the skill1 ATK contribution as an upper bound until a recording shows the real uptime.

flags.reasoning: Kit trigger is 'own HP falls below 90%'. The sim has no HP pool and the scope-lock boss is non-damaging, so the literal trigger is unreachable and a faithful encoding would make the buff permanently dead. Neither extreme is knowable from the kit text alone. Chose always-on so the buff is at least visible to a tuner, and flagged it as the dominant error source. A 5.19% caster-ATK flat add to all allies is small but not negligible across a 5-unit team.
flags.recipe: In a real fight, watch ade's HP bar for the first drop below 90% and time from there; if she is never damaged in a solo-raid scope-lock run the buff is genuinely dead and skill1[0] should be deleted (or the block gated off). Cross-check with a buffApply event filter on stat 'casterAtkPct' value ≈ (5.19/100)×ade.staticAtk in the harness.

flags.reasoning: 'normal attack(s)' is read as ROUNDS, matching the hitCount trigger's documented semantics (counts rounds, not pulls). ade is AR with hitsPerShot 1 and ammo 60, so 120 rounds ≈ two full magazines. Whether the game counts pulls, landed hits, or rounds is not stated in the kit text.
flags.recipe: Count ade's shots to the first buff-icon appearance in footage; or in the harness, log buffApply events for stat 'maxHpFlat' from ade's casterIdx and compare the firing frames against her shot events (cumulative round count at each apply).

flags.reasoning: The lines sit in ade's OWN burst block with no 'when entering Full Burst' wording, so per the trigger-identity rule this is burst-cast, firing only on rotations where ade actually bursts. Keying it to fullBurstEnter would over-credit in any comp with another Burst II unit.
flags.recipe: Run a comp with a second Burst II and check whether the ATK buff appears on rotations ade does not cast. If it does, re-key to fullBurstEnter.

flags.reasoning: 'of the skill user's Max HP' selects casterMaxHpPct over targetMaxHpPct. Per the e3 rule, ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct conversion, so these grants move zero damage unless a teammate with HP-scaling ATK is present AND the conversion rule is later revised. Kept per the 'never skip HP lines' rule and as a future consumer.
flags.recipe: A/B the comp with and without the two casterMaxHpPct effects; confirm the per-unit totals are identical. If a teammate carries atkOfMaxHpPct, re-verify the e3 caster===target rule holds before assuming inertness.

flags.reasoning: Debuff immunity has no representation in EffectDef and the sim models no incoming debuffs or status effects on allies. This is a genuine no-damage-path skip, distinct from the heal/shield/DEF/HP lines the HARD RULES forbid skipping (those can drive teammate on-recovery/on-shield consumers; debuff immunity has no such known consumer).
flags.recipe: If a future unit's kit gates damage on 'while not debuffed' or similar, revisit — Perfect Maid would then become a tandem enabler and need a schema kind.
